notes.subject: to दानियेल
notes.rationale: The speaker addresses Daniel directly with the singular 'तूँ', closing the book with a personal charge.

notes.subject: हिस्सा
notes.rationale: גורל literally a pebble used for casting lots; 'हिस्सा' (allotted portion) keeps the sense, the pebble-picture is lost.

notes.subject: לקץ...לקץ
notes.rationale: The repetition of 'अन्त' frames the verse — go to the end, stand at the end of days — a rhetorical envelope Magahi keeps.

notes.subject: अन्त
notes.rationale: The verse seals the book's withheld timetable ('the end') without revealing it — the words are closed and Daniel is told to rest.

translation: आउ तूँ जा अन्त ले, आउ आराम करबइ, आउ खड़ा होतइ अपन हिस्सा बर, दिन के अन्त में।
